_about: Narration for the Storyraise Analytics walkthrough. `text` is what viewers read in captions; [[cue:name]] markers are stripped before TTS and become timestamps visuals land on. `respell` maps a caption word to how the voice should say it (applied to the TTS text only). Labels match the product UI; star rules match the server (functions/index.js ~11819). American English, no em dashes.

scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: You sent your impact report. [[cue:question]]Did it land? [[cue:brand]]Storyraise Analytics shows you who read it, what held their attention, and who might be ready to hear from you.

scenes.title: What's new
scenes._disabled: Cut 2026-09-10 (Vince): the 'your totals look lower' message reads as a negative in a promotional video. Set enabled to true to restore; its narration take is still cached.
scenes.text: [[cue:rebuilt]]Analytics has been rebuilt. [[cue:reloads]]Page reloads no longer inflate your numbers, [[cue:team]]and your own team's visits are left out automatically. [[cue:lower]]So if your totals look a little lower than before, that isn't a drop. It's accuracy.

scenes.title: Where to find it
scenes.text: [[cue:home]]Your Home tab shows what's being read across all of your reports. [[cue:open]]Open any report's Analytics for the full picture, in two views: [[cue:numbers]]The Numbers, and [[cue:story]]The Story.

scenes.title: The top row
scenes.text: Up top, [[cue:opened]]Constituents Opened counts the people on your list who opened their personalized link, and [[cue:returns]]Constituent Returns shows how many came back. [[cue:views]]Views counts every visit, repeats included. [[cue:time]]And Average Time Spent is the average reader's total time, across all of their visits.

scenes.title: Highlights and the map
scenes.text: [[cue:chips]]Highlights do the first read for you, like when readers peak. [[cue:map]]And the map shows roughly where your audience is reading from.

scenes.title: Most Engaged Constituents
scenes.text: [[cue:list]]With personalized links, you see names. Most Engaged Constituents ranks your standouts with an Engagement Score. [[cue:star1]]One star means they read longer than the typical constituent on this report. [[cue:star2]]Two stars, they also got through at least half of it. [[cue:star3]]Three stars, they took action too, by clicking a link or coming back. [[cue:badges]]And badges flag key actions, like a donation click, even when the stars don't.

scenes.title: Where The Clicks Go
scenes.text: [[cue:donut]]Where The Clicks Go groups every link click by what readers wanted, from donating to opening a document. [[cue:attention]]Reading shows attention. [[cue:intent]]Clicking shows intent.

scenes.title: How They Read
scenes.text: [[cue:sections]]How They Read shows how far people get. [[cue:retention]]Section Retention traces their path from section to section, [[cue:endcap]]and the red edge marks where visits ended. [[cue:drop]]A big drop after your opening tells you exactly what to tighten.

scenes.title: When They Visit
scenes.text: [[cue:heatmap]]Top Visit Times shows the days and times of day people actually read, [[cue:trend]]so your next send can land when your readers show up.

scenes.title: The Story
scenes.text: [[cue:storytab]]Short on time? The Story sums it all up in plain English, [[cue:followup]]with people worth a follow-up and ideas for next time, [[cue:download]]ready to download and share.

scenes.title: Personalized links
scenes.text: [[cue:anon]]Remember: anonymous links tell you how your report performed. [[cue:personal]]Personalized links tell you who to call on Monday.

scenes.title: Explore the demo
scenes.text: [[cue:cta]]See every part of it for yourself in the interactive demo, right here on this page.
